database: Legendary Picks dev SQLite database, opened with mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only=ON

definitions.drive_clock_span: max minus min game_seconds_remaining among retained rows in a drive; snap-clock span, not exact possession time
definitions.drive_terminal: series_result on the last retained play_id in each non-null (game_id, drive)
definitions.epa_success: The source success flag is EPA-positive; it is not a first-down or scoring flag.
definitions.first_down_series_terminal: series_result='First down' counted only on the last play_id within (game_id, series); result consistency is validated
definitions.game_scores: official retained nfl_schedule home_score and away_score; never reconstructed from PBP flags
definitions.histogram_nulls: Source nulls are represented as a literal NULL value in distribution tables unless the metric explicitly requires complete source coverage.
definitions.play_condition_population: play_type in pass/run/no_play, down 1-4, nonnegative ydstogo, yardline_100 0-99
definitions.player_games: role-specific non-null nfl_pbp player IDs grouped by game_id; no names or IDs exported
definitions.player_targets: receiver player-games include only pass_attempt rows with receiver_player_id; missing receiver IDs are counted in coverage
definitions.rushing_yards: yard histogram includes only player-games with non-null rushing_yards on every rush_attempt; exclusions are listed in player_stat_coverage.csv

window.season_type: regular season, verified by exact game-key parity with nfl_schedule REG
